findings.title: Removing the existing mark_failed module helpers breaks their import contract
findings.body: This refactor deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, and `get_monitor_environment_context` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` rather than retaining compatibility aliases or updating all consumers. Any existing worker code, integrations, or tests importing these previously available functions will now fail with `ImportError` at startup/test collection. Keep forwarding aliases in this module (at least for the renamed functions) or update every import site as part of the change.
